svg.aria-label: Setting up a port: git clone Chisel as port-foo, then python3 tools/chisel-init.py turns it into your workbench repo, imports the original code into source/foo/, creates your product repo and clones it as foo-c/ beside port-foo/, not inside it, and chooses the models; the first /port-sprint-start commits and pushes the setup

svg.text: Joining a port someone started? Run the same chisel-init from any clone of Chisel and choose “join”: it clones their workbench and product side by side.
